connect.accountHint: This is whoever was signed in on Seafile's page when you connected, not necessarily your mail account. To change it, use another Seafile account. If Seafile's page signs in the wrong person again, log out there first. If Seafile signs you in through your organisation (single sign-on), sign out there as well.
connect.approving: Confirm the server in the dialog.
connect.waiting: Approve access in the Seafile tab that just opened ({host}). This updates by itself once you're done.
connect.expired: Your Seafile sign-in has expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
connect.intro: Connect your Seafile to attach files from it, send large files as links and save attachments to it.
connect.title: Seafile isn't connected
connect.tokenHint: Seafile shows the token in your settings under Web API Auth Token, if your administrator turned that on.
connect.tokenInstead: You can connect with an API token instead.
settings.title: Seafile account
settings.privacy: The access token is kept on the webmail server, not in this plugin. Disconnecting deletes it there. If Seafile lists the webmail under Linked devices, it is also unlinked there.
firstrun.offer: Seafile is available. Connect your account in Settings > Plugins > Seafile.
error.auth: Your Seafile sign-in has expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
error.forbidden: Seafile doesn't allow this for your account.
error.share_forbidden: Seafile doesn't let you share this with a link. Ask your Seafile administrator.
error.not_found: That file or folder no longer exists in Seafile.
error.exists: There is already a file or folder with that name.
error.quota: Your Seafile storage is full. Free up some space and try again.
error.too_large: The file is too large to transfer.
error.locked: The file is locked in Seafile, probably because someone is editing it. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests to Seafile. Wait a minute and try again.
error.timeout: Seafile didn't answer in time. Try again.
error.unreachable: Couldn't reach your Seafile server. Check the address or try again later.
error.blocked: The webmail isn't allowed to connect to this server. Ask your administrator.
error.maintenance: Seafile isn't available right now. Try again later.
error.server: Seafile ran into an error. Try again later.
error.wrong_server: Your administrator set a different Seafile server. Connect again.
error.wrong_server_host: Your administrator set Seafile to {host}. Connect to that server.
error.login_expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
error.bad_answer: Seafile sent an answer the plugin doesn't understand.
error.attach_refused: The composer didn't accept the file. The message may be too large.
error.attach_refused_name: The composer didn't accept {name}. The message may be too large.
error.mail_rate_limited: The mail server is getting too many requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
error.mail_upload: The mail server didn't accept the file.
error.no_browser_signin: This Seafile server doesn't offer sign-in through the browser. Your administrator can turn it on.
error.not_seafile: No Seafile server answers at this address.
error.token_rejected: Seafile didn't accept this token. Check it and try again.
error.file_server: Seafile hands out file addresses on another server, which the webmail can't use. Ask your administrator to check Seafile's address settings.
error.encrypted: Encrypted libraries can't be opened here. Open them in Seafile.
browser.noFavorites: No favorites yet. Mark files or folders with a star in Seafile to find them here.
share.usePassword: Protect the link with a password
share.includePassword: Put the password in the message
share.sendSeparately: Send the password to the recipients another way, for example by phone.
share.expiryHint: After this date the link stops working.
share.title: Share {name}
picker.title: Attach from Seafile
links.title: Files shared with Seafile
offload.title: Large attachment
offload.intro: {name} is {size}. Upload it to your Seafile and put a link in the message instead? Recipients then download it from Seafile.
offload.paused: Upload paused. Resume to continue where it stopped.
page.title: Seafile
files.uploadHint: You can also drop files here to upload them to this folder.
files.name: Name
files.linkReady: The link is ready. Copy it from here:
setting.passwordProtect: Protect share links with a password
setting.passwordProtect.help: Start with a password for new share links. You can change it each time.
setting.expiryDays.help: Default expiry for new share links. 0 means they don't expire.
setting.offerLargeUpload: Offer to send large attachments as a Seafile link
setting.offerLargeUpload.help: When you attach a file of the large attachment size or more, ask whether to upload it to Seafile and add a link instead.
setting.largeFileMb.help: Files from this size on get the offer.
setting.uploadFolder.help: A library in your Seafile, or a folder in one, for files uploaded from the webmail, for example Mail attachments or My Library/Mail attachments. Created when needed.
setting.folderLayout.help: How uploads are sorted in the upload folder.
